name: sqlite-model-storage
goal: A reusable SQLite adapter powers generated models and a queryable local project catalog with a model for every table

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Scope: reusable driver-injected adapter; explicit table models; queryable Git-derived SQLite catalog. Red: generated SQLite create throws its starting-point error; deterministic history build lacks catalog.sqlite. Commands and failures: /tmp/harness-sqlite-red.log.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: Implemented driver-injected SQLite adapter and generators, model definitions for eight catalog tables and the existing events/switches tables, atomic Git-derived catalog indexing, public sqlite/catalog package entries and usage documentation. Scope confirmed by Daniel: build the project catalog.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Red evidence: /tmp/harness-sqlite-red.log (stub CRUD and missing catalog); additional schema/metadata/dependency regressions captured. Green: /tmp/harness-sqlite-final-focused.log (15 passing), /tmp/harness-sqlite-scaffold.log (8 passing), history integration 4 passing, packed API consumer passes both Bun and Node. Required full check remains running; verify step stays pending.
